pp.apertiSend: Show tables open on the till
pp.apertiHint: Every minute the CRM reads the till's open orders: those tables show as busy on the floor plan, at reception and on the bookings map, even without a booking.

pp.qrSubtitle: Tables open on the till can pay from their phone
pp.qrSend: Let tables open on the till pay from the QR
pp.qrHint: The table QR shows «Pay the bill» even when the order exists only on the till. On tap the CRM reads the order, the guest pays (in full, split evenly or by dish, deposit already deducted) and once settled the till closes the table with {{tipo}}. If something is added on the till after payment, the table is not closed automatically and the till gets an alert with the difference.
pp.qrHintNoType: The table QR shows «Pay the bill» even when the order exists only on the till, and once settled the till closes the table by itself.
pp.qrNeedPay: Pay at table must be on: Settings → Pay at table.
pp.qrNeedType: Choose the till payment type above, in «Connection and till closing»: the till closes tables paid from the QR with it.
pp.qrNodo: With full service on the dining-room node, bills are opened by the node: paying till orders from the QR stays off.

pp.qrNow_other: {{count}} tables open on the till right now

pp.specchioNoPlant: Read the tables from the till in «Bookings on the till» to choose it.
pp.specchioGenericHint: Dishes created in the CRM, which the till doesn't have, go to the till with this item, with their own name and price. The service charge goes through it too.

pp.specchioHint: Every bill closed in the CRM becomes an order on the chosen till table, with no kitchen tickets, closed as a pro forma paid with {{tipo}}: no receipt from the till and takings are not counted twice. The till prints the pro forma slip.
pp.specchioHintNoType: Every bill closed in the CRM becomes an order on the chosen till table, closed as a pro forma: the till payment type is required.

pp.vivoSubtitle: Orders taken in the CRM also on the till, on the real table
pp.vivoSend: Write CRM orders to the till
pp.vivoHint: Every order sent from the CRM goes into the till order of its table and grows with additions. If the table is already open on the till, the CRM lines are added to the same order. Don't keep a table open on the till while it receives orders from the CRM: on saving, the till would lose its changes.
pp.vivoPrint: Who prints in the kitchen and at the bar
pp.vivoByCrmBillToo: The CRM (only with the CRM bill)
pp.vivoPrintHintCassa: Courses fired in the CRM are sent to production by the till, on its printers. The CRM station printers don't print these tables; kitchen monitors stay. If the till doesn't answer, the CRM prints after a few seconds.
pp.vivoPrintHintCrm: The CRM's station printers print, and the CRM makes the bill. On the till, don't press «Send» or close these tables from the screen: it would send the CRM's items to production a second time. The table is closed by the payment in the CRM (the agent must be up to date).
pp.vivoBillHintCassa: The bill is the till order, with the till's cover charge and discounts. Guests pay at the till, from the table QR or from the CRM, which takes it from the till.
pp.vivoBillHintCrm: The bill is built from the CRM's items, with the CRM's cover charge and discounts. Paid in the CRM or by QR, it closes the order on the till with the external payment type and the till issues the receipt, if the totals match; the discount goes on the till's bill, as when the till applies it. If something was rung up at the till or on the handheld for the table, the till makes the bill.
pp.vivoNeedOrders: Turn on orders, in Settings → Floor & kitchen.
pp.vivoNeedTables: Pair the CRM tables with the till ones, in the «Bookings on the till» card.
pp.vivoNeedType: Choose the till payment type above, in «Connection and till closing».
pp.vivoNoGeneric: Dishes that exist only in the CRM go to the till with the item for CRM dishes, chosen above in «CRM bills on the till».

verifica.rivenditoreTitle: What to ask the till dealer
verifica.rivenditoreTesto:
To connect Sympotia to the Passepartout till you need:
1. The Passepartout Web Service (AdapterWS) on, with a user dedicated to Sympotia.
2. The Web Service port (usually 7606) reachable from the till PC.
3. A dedicated payment type (e.g. ESTERNO) that reads as electronic payment on the receipt.
4. The circuit guests pay with from the QR linked to the fiscal printer (POS-RT linking).
5. The till PC on during service.
